01 / Featured
Governance & Compliance Analysis Dashboard

A governance and compliance analytics solution designed to provide management with a consolidated view of policy compliance, issue status, and risk exposure across departments. The dashboard addresses the need for centralized monitoring by bringing key compliance indicators into one interactive platform, helping management identify performance gaps, prioritize corrective actions, and track progress toward the 90% compliance target.

Power BI DAX Power Query HTML CSS UI/UX
77%
Compliance Rate
2402
Total Issues
166
Overdue Issues
13%
Gap to 90% Target

// Key Functionality

  • ▸Compliance Performance Monitoring: tracks overall compliance rates, overdue issues, non-compliant records, and progress toward the 90% target.
  • ▸Departmental Risk Analysis: highlights departments with high concentrations of critical issues and identifies areas requiring management attention.
  • ▸Policy Compliance Analysis: identifies policies with the highest number of non-compliance cases to support targeted reviews and corrective action.
  • ▸Risk & Issue Tracking: categorizes issues by risk level and compliance status, providing visibility into outstanding concerns and their distribution.
  • ▸Trend Analysis: monitors changes in compliance performance over time to support ongoing evaluation and follow-up.

Analysis Approach: Compliance records were analyzed across departments, policy categories, risk levels, and issue statuses to assess organizational performance and identify areas requiring further investigation. The analysis highlights a 77% compliance rate, a 13-percentage-point gap against the 90% target, and 166 overdue issues. Finance and HR are among the departments highlighted for risk exposure, while Data Protection and Procurement policies show notable concentrations of non-compliance cases.

// Business Value

  • ✦Provides management with a centralized view of compliance performance and organizational risk.
  • ✦Helps prioritize corrective actions based on departmental exposure and policy-level gaps.
  • ✦Supports more structured monitoring of overdue issues and outstanding compliance concerns.
  • ✦Enables performance tracking against the 90% compliance target and facilitates data-informed management decisions.

// Business Questions Addressed

  • ?What is the current compliance rate across departments?
  • ?Which departments are most at risk?
  • ?Which policies show the most violations?
  • ?How close are we to the 90% compliance target?
02
Airline Customer Experience & Operations Analytics

Developed an interactive analytics solution to investigate the factors influencing passenger satisfaction and evaluate airline service quality and operational performance. The dashboard addresses the need to understand where service gaps exist, how satisfaction varies across passenger segments, and how flight delays relate to the overall travel experience. By analyzing over 1.03 million passenger records, the project provides a consolidated view of customer experience and operational indicators to support data-driven service improvement and management decisions.

Power BI DAX Power Query UI/UX Storytelling HTML
1.03M+
Passengers Analyzed
43.4%
Satisfaction Rate
3.33
Avg Service Rating
15 min
Avg Flight Delay

// Key Functionality

  • ▸Executive Overview: summarizes passenger volume, overall satisfaction, satisfied passengers, and average flight delays.
  • ▸Service Quality Analysis: compares ratings across service categories, identifies the highest- and lowest-rated services, and examines performance across travel classes.
  • ▸Customer Segmentation: analyzes passenger satisfaction and demographics by travel type, gender, age group, travel class, and customer loyalty.
  • ▸Delay Impact Analysis: examines delay frequency, average departure and arrival delays, and patterns across flight-distance categories.
  • ▸Interactive Filtering: enables users to explore results across passenger segments and travel categories to investigate specific performance patterns.
  • ▸Executive Recommendations: translates analytical findings into targeted improvement opportunities for onboard services, flight operations, seat comfort, and passenger retention.

Analysis Approach: The analysis combines descriptive analytics, service-rating comparisons, passenger segmentation, and delay analysis to identify performance gaps and areas requiring further investigation. Key findings include an overall passenger satisfaction rate of 43.4%, an average service rating of 3.33, and an average flight delay of 15 minutes. Wi-Fi received the lowest service rating at 2.73, while crew service ranked highest at 3.64. The analysis also found that 54.2% of passengers experienced delays, highlighting an operational area for further investigation alongside service quality and customer experience.

// Business Value

  • ✦Identifies underperforming service categories and highlights opportunities to improve the passenger experience.
  • ✦Helps management compare service performance across travel classes and customer segments.
  • ✦Provides visibility into flight delays and their relationship with passenger experience indicators.
  • ✦Supports the development of targeted, evidence-based recommendations for service and operational improvement.

// Business Questions Addressed

  • ?Why are 56.5% of passengers dissatisfied?
  • ?Which service category needs the most improvement?
  • ?Do business travelers experience more delays than personal travelers?
03
HR Analytics & Workforce Strategy

An interactive, end-to-end HR analytics solution designed to transform workforce data into actionable business insights. The dashboard analyzes 96,000 employee records across workforce performance, productivity, payroll and compensation, workplace satisfaction, training, and employee retention. Through interactive dashboards and cross-departmental analysis, the solution explores relationships between employee performance, compensation, training investment, overtime, and workforce stability, enabling comparisons of departmental trends and evaluation of workforce indicators to support more informed, data-driven HR and management decisions.

Power BI DAX Power Query M Language Data Modeling Dashboard Design

// Key Functionality

  • ▸Workforce Performance: compares performance scores, productivity indicators, and departmental benchmarks to identify performance gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • ▸Payroll & Compensation: analyzes payroll distribution by department and job role, compares compensation patterns, and explores the relationship between salary and performance.
  • ▸Employee Well-being: examines workplace satisfaction, overtime, and sick-day patterns to understand potential workforce well-being concerns.
  • ▸Training Effectiveness: explores the relationship between training hours and employee performance to assess whether training investment aligns with performance outcomes.
  • ▸Retention & Workforce Stability: analyzes employee departures, tenure, and attrition patterns to identify areas that may require further investigation and retention-focused action.
  • ▸Employee-Level Analysis: uses employee search and interactive department filters to move from organization-wide indicators to individual employee records.

Analysis Approach: Employee-level data was analyzed across departments to examine the relationship between overtime, training investment, performance, and attrition. Higher overtime levels were associated with lower employee satisfaction, underscoring the importance of workload balance, while training investment showed a measurable positive relationship with performance — together pointing to workload management and training as relevant levers for retention and performance.

// Business Value

  • ✦Consolidates multiple HR indicators into a unified analytical view.
  • ✦Supports comparisons across departments, job roles, and workforce segments.
  • ✦Helps decision-makers investigate performance, compensation, and retention patterns.
  • ✦Provides an analytical foundation for workforce planning and evidence-based HR decisions.

// Business Questions Addressed

  • ?What factors drive employee attrition?
  • ?Does higher training investment improve performance?
  • ?How does overtime impact employee well-being?
04
Transit & Transfer Movement Analysis — Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport 2025

A Power BI analytical dashboard developed to examine transit and transfer movement through Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Madinah during 2025. The project aims to identify movement patterns, monitor quarterly changes, and understand the main countries and airport entry points contributing to transit activity.

Power BI DAX Power Query Azure Maps Interactive Data Visualization
579
Total Transit Movements
168%
Quarterly Growth Rate
80.14%
Top Country Share (KSA)
45.77%
Top Entry Point Share

// Dashboard Functionality

  • ▸Quarterly Movement Analysis: tracks transit volume changes across operational quarters.
  • ▸Country-Level Comparison: compares transit contribution by country of origin.
  • ▸Entry-Point Ranking: identifies the leading airport entry points for transit traffic.
  • ▸Geographic Visualization: maps transit distribution using Azure Maps for spatial context.
  • ▸Interactive Filtering: quarter and country filters let users explore movement distributions and compare operational periods.

Key Findings: Transit movement records were analyzed by quarter, origin country, and entry point to identify seasonal patterns and the concentration of transit traffic. The dataset recorded 579 transit and transfer movements, with Q4 registering the highest quarterly volume at 252 movements. Saudi Arabia accounted for 80.14% of recorded movements, and the leading entry point represented 45.77% of total movements.

// Business Value

  • ✦Highlights peak operational periods and quarterly movement trends.
  • ✦Identifies the leading countries and airport entry points contributing to transit activity.
  • ✦Supports data-driven analysis of movement patterns for operational monitoring and planning.
  • ✦Provides a consolidated view of transit activity to help stakeholders investigate changes and prioritize further analysis.

// Business Questions Addressed

  • ?Which countries generate the most transit traffic?
  • ?What drives the 168% quarterly growth in Q4?
